```yaml
name: Code Review
on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  code-review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Run Code Review
        uses: github/codeql-action@v2
        with:
          language: javascript
          category: "javascript"
          query: "javascript/audit"
          fail-on-error: false
          output: sarif-results

      - name: Comment on PR
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const fs = require('fs');
            const { execSync } = require('child_process');
            
            // Get changed files
            const changedFiles = [];
            try {
              const output = execSync('git diff --name-only HEAD~1 HEAD', { encoding: 'utf8' });
              output.split('\n').filter(line => line.trim()).forEach(file => changedFiles.push(file));
            } catch (error) {
              console.log('Could not determine changed files:', error.message);
            }
            
            // Create review comment
            const comment = `
## Code Review Suggestions

### Documentation Consistency
Please ensure all files have comprehensive \`@file\` documentation blocks matching legacy standards:
- Popup helpers
- Entry points  
- Models
- Search strategies
- Views

### Scoring Pipeline Clarity
Highlight scoring pipeline steps with clear comments to maintain historical behavior parity.

### Code Comments
Add consistent inline comments explaining complex logic and decision points.

### Historical Behavior Preservation
Maintain consistency with legacy implementation details while improving documentation quality.

This review focuses on documentation consistency and clarity rather than functional changes.
            `;
            
            github.rest.issues.createComment({
              issue_number: context.issue.number,
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              body: comment
            });
```
